text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Starting today, my trainee and I will be taking on the Twinkle Series. The Umamusume joining me for this journey is none other than…

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: I'm Matikanetannhauser. Nice to meet you!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Ehehe, I want to try and pull off some awesome races that'll make people happy.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: All right, I'm gonna train hard! Ei, ei, mun!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And so, <chrname> and I take our first steps towards competing in the Twinkle Series!
